_comment: Each entry lets ONE citation in ONE row/mode stay as cited despite ONE named newer record of
the same campaign and mode. No wildcards, no campaign-wide or implicit-historical entries.
An exception authorizes retaining that citation only; it never authorizes weakening a verdict
or a ratified spec. Unused, duplicate or dangling entries fail the check: when the newer
record is cited, or the citation moves, delete the entry in the same PR.

Issue #393 paired same-commit (800bf53) ideal-supply CONTROL arm of the V_DD-network campaign, on the same layout/adc-top/parasitics/reports/20260923-094816-904af96 extraction this citation used. It reads this row's term at 0.0010063 LSB against this citation's 0.000981002 LSB, same corner (ff_-40c_3.63v) and same PASS, ~500x inside 0.5 LSB. Not bit-identical. Issue #459 isolated the cause from committed evidence (sim/dr0014-sampling/investigations/20261009-issue-459-gain-error-control-arm-delta.md). The deck bytes (4fea809d...), manifest and harness are identical. The difference is a solver-path difference between two ngspice-46 execution environments (the /home/ubuntu host family, no compat mode, vs a /Users/rwalters workstation, compat mode 'hs a'; Linux vs macOS is inferred from those install paths only). The environment also includes the unrecorded ngspice init state and PDK model bytes; only the open_pdks pin is recorded. It shifts all five tp_inj_p levels by a common ~-0.0067 LSB, and max-min keeps only a +2.5e-5 LSB residue. Same-environment repeats are bit-identical. It is a same-deck control for a sensitivity experiment in a different environment, not a re-take that moves this row's governing figure.
